# R17 V2 qualification references

This directory contains only machine-readable source locks, license text, and original Matrix Oasis adaptation notes. It contains no upstream executable source, binary, model, asset, or qualification output.

All executable checkouts, dependency installations, archives, logs, and evidence remain under `C:\tmp`. The tracked lock records their exact immutable identities without making them runtime dependencies.

Godogen and GameCraft-Bench remain governed by the frozen R13 reference lock and are referenced by hash rather than copied again.
